The Dial In Collective · independent source audit

Every selected coffee.
Every comparison visible.

603 coffees from 201 U.S. roasters, three distinct products each. This report keeps the frozen expected values, original-source evidence, baseline results, repaired candidate, and remaining questions together.

Successful preview is not complete extraction. Strict field comparisons, supplementary evidence retention, ambiguity handling, and post-replay source reviews are separate measures. Source integration is recorded separately below; this report does not establish deployment or perfect coverage.

Measured results

FieldExpectedBaseline exactCandidate exactCandidate blankNeeds review

How to interpret these numbers

    Implemented improvements

    Inspect all 603 cases

    Search by coffee, roaster, state or source URL. Open any case to compare the original expected value with both versions and inspect the source quotes, supplementary facts and capture hashes.

    Reproducibility

    The original expected values were locked before per-case outputs were opened. Separate post-replay reviews identify repairs, equivalences, disagreements and oracle omissions without rewriting that independent lock.

    This self-contained report loads no remote scripts, images or data. Clicking an explicit roaster source link opens that website. Sources can change after capture; the recorded bytes and hashes are the audit evidence.
